# JPG Spinner privacy notice

Applies to JPG Spinner 2.0 by Hadden Industries Ltd. Last updated: 26 October 2026. This notice describes this version of the app; the historical Store version may behave differently.

Your photos are processed on your device. JPG Spinner has no image-upload service, advertising, account system or custom network telemetry. Diagnostic records stay on your device unless you choose to export and share them.

## Photos and local processing

The app reads the folders you select, including photo content and metadata such as orientation, camera information and potentially location or other personal information. It uses this information to analyze and correct image orientation and preserve supported metadata. Image analysis does not change your files. Processing writes corrected copies, or replaces originals only through the reviewed backup workflow. The app does not send photos or metadata to Hadden Industries.

## Settings, folder access and recovery

Processing preferences and retained Windows folder-access permissions are stored under this app's local identity. Recovery journals contain file identities, paths and transaction facts needed to recover interrupted work. Originals, corrected copies, verified backups and journals are operational data, not sanitized diagnostic logs. They are not covered by diagnostic rotation; backups do not expire automatically.

You choose the source folder, processing options and whether to start reviewed work. You can change preferences in Settings and manage Windows app permissions in Windows Settings. Manage photos, exported files and backups in their chosen folders. Keep recovery data and backups until interrupted work is reconciled and you no longer need recovery; deleting them can prevent recovery. Uninstalling or resetting an app is not a substitute for deleting copies or exports in other folders.

## Local diagnostics and retention

To help diagnose failures, the app records the UTC time, app version and architecture, a random per-operation identifier, processing stage, error code, elapsed time and resource-limit information when available. Missing optional values are recorded as null. The identifier groups one operation; it is not a stable device identifier. Records use UTF-8 JSON Lines (.jsonl) in the app-local LocalDiagnostics folder.

These records exclude filenames, paths, photo bytes, thumbnails, Exif/XMP/IPTC metadata, GPS coordinates, arbitrary native exception messages, network endpoints and stable device identifiers. Windows crash reports are separate from these app diagnostic records.

Diagnostic storage is limited by size and file count, rather than a fixed number of days: at most 256 KiB and 64 retained record files, with each record at most 4,096 bytes. The reserved pending slot counts toward the storage budget and is never exported; the empty writer lease is not a record. Rotation removes only recognized, validated diagnostic records. Unknown, corrupt or unsupported files are preserved and cause logging or export to refuse rather than silently delete or disclose them. A logging failure does not fail image processing.

## Exporting and sharing diagnostics

Export local diagnostics asks you to choose a destination using the Windows file picker. It exports a bounded, revalidated snapshot of sanitized records, not arbitrary files from the diagnostic folder. Nothing is submitted automatically. Review the export before sharing: times, outcomes and resource limits can still be sensitive. You control who receives it and when to delete it. A failed or cancelled export may leave a partial file at the chosen destination; export is not guaranteed to be atomic.

## Windows, cloud providers and websites

The app declares no network capability and adds no custom upload transport. Selecting a cloud-backed source, output or export location can nevertheless cause its provider to download or sync files, including photos or diagnostic exports. Windows and Microsoft Store may handle crash reporting, installation information or other diagnostics under your Windows choices and Microsoft's policies. These services operate separately from the app's local diagnostic log.

The app's privacy notice is available here offline. Opening an external policy link launches your browser; the website receives ordinary connection information, such as your IP address, and may use cookies under its own policy. No photo or diagnostic export is attached to these links.

## Questions and information you share with us

For app privacy questions, contact Hadden Industries Ltd at info@haddenindustries.com. The publisher cannot retrieve photos or diagnostic files kept only on your device. If you contact us or choose to send us an export, that correspondence and any information you include are handled under the publisher's separate privacy policy, linked below. Do not send recovery journals, photos or other personal information unless you intend to share them.
